question: Propane and butane are the main components of which of the following gases?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__LPG.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Propane and Butane are the main components of **LPG.**
 
• LPG is **liquefied petroleum gas**.
 
• These are both flammable hydrocarbon gases used as fuel for LPG heating gases, cooking, and vehicular fuel.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• CNG is commonly used in **Auto rickshaws, Cars as well as Buses**.
 
• LNG contains **more than 90% of methane. **In our daily life routine we can commonly use it for natural gas include **cooking, heating homes, and generating electricity.**
 
• The primary components of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) are:
 
 
• **P****ropane.**
 
• **Butane.**
 
• **Propylene.**
 
• **Butylene.**
 
• **Isobutane**.
